figma.format: SVG exports; interface layers are vectors; embedded photos are source portraits.
figma.repairs: The exporter omitted mixed per-region fills on chart nodes 3158:20527 and 3158:19358 and used an unsupported HTML backdrop blur. Read-only Plugin API data in chart-source.json and dashboard-chart-source.json restores the original ten vector regions and source colors of each chart; a native SVG Gaussian blur preserves the original 12px effect. Reproduce each with scripts/moscow/repair_chart.py.

videos: All thirteen demos use local files in «видео ПМ». Exact mapping, dimensions and SHA-256 in video-manifest.json. Telegram uses «чат-бот.mov», not the earlier Buildin video. The Telegram web versions are trimmed to 14.0 seconds, before the recording selection border and stop-recording tooltip. Original retained unchanged.

authorClarifications.role: All stages in a team of designers; Government of Moscow team were the stakeholders. Research, UI, prototypes, stakeholder communication and final pitch.
authorClarifications.metric: 50% to 70% is the target for conversion between individual selection stages, not end-to-end completion.
authorClarifications.delivery: Presented to stakeholders; implementation scope and timing are unknown and are not represented as measured impact.
authorClarifications.mechanics: Return advantage and consideration of candidate activity were proposed and discussed with stakeholders.

editorial: The source calls the already-focused favorites user «Самозванец» once, while its definition and the preceding segmentation describe «Искушённый». The page uses the consistent mindset mapping. A duplicate insight description under «Да кому я там нужен?» is replaced with a faithful paraphrase of its accompanying quote. Two interview quotes are shown as exact excerpts to avoid rewriting the original wording.
